run_mrp_ifttt_setup: run the MRP setup script to start the IFTTT webhook and trigger event detector processes
create_mrp_process_conda: create an MRP process that runs a Python script inside a Conda environment with custom config
configure_ifttt_webhook_process: configure an MRP process for an IFTTT webhook using a key and event name
configure_trigger_event_detector_process: configure an MRP process for a trigger event detector with an event topic
review_mrp_main_entry: review the MRP main entry point that starts all defined processes when run directly
